description: EXPLORATORY. Route 3's splitting argument needs only ONE component separated, not all three: mubar_abc is the h_a h_b coefficient of lambda_c, so if c splits off from the pair it vanishes however strongly a and b are linked. Reclassifying the derived carrier's triples by SHAPE rather than by Delta: SEPARABLE (some component unlinked from both others -- the argument reaches it) vs CHAIN (none is). On the all-sigma^-1 branch, 393 SEPARABLE and 31 CHAIN, 0 nonzero mubar in either. The merged Delta = 0 theorem reaches only the 211 that are separable AND Delta = 0; the 182 separable Delta = 2 triples are reached for the first time: coverage 211 -> 393 of 424, i.e. 49.8 % -> 92.7 %, which is +42.9 percentage POINTS or +86.3 % relative -- both stated because '43 % more' reads as the relative figure and is not it. From deleting a hypothesis rather than adding an argument. The 31 CHAIN triples are VERIFIED (not inferred from the count matching sum(A-1)) to be exactly the consecutive {i, i+1, i+2}, and the companion Lean proves that is forced with no third case, so the residual is ONE SHAPE and cannot be chipped at further by linking-number bookkeeping. Closing it needs a different invariant -- mubar vanishing unless all indices lie in one connected-sum summand -- which is NOT asserted here. The chain null is generic for monotone words and the non-monotone arm is the positive control that it is a fact about monotonicity rather than about the scanner. Also records that #6679's monotone null is 53.7 % NON-vacuous (690 of its triples are Delta = 2, not Delta = 1). Scope (a) for the measurement; the scope-(b) exclusion lives in the Lean. Nothing wired.

the_strengthening.merged_hypothesis: Delta = 0 -- ALL THREE pairwise linking numbers vanish (MilnorTriplesAreDefinedExactlyWhereTheyVanish.lean)
the_strengthening.what_the_argument_needs: ONE component unlinked from both others. mubar_abc is the h_a h_b coefficient of the Magnus expansion of lambda_c; if c splits off from the pair that coefficient is zero, and a, b may be linked to each other arbitrarily
the_strengthening.companion_lean: QOU/Mass/OneSeparatedComponentSufficesForMilnorVanishing.lean -- sorry-free, lean-direct exit 0; splitsOff_of_unlinked depends on NO axioms
the_strengthening.gain_on_the_carrier: the merged theorem reaches 211 (separable AND Delta = 0); this reaches all 393 separable, adding the 182 that are Delta = 2 with one component unlinked from both

the_chain_is_the_consecutive_triple.verified_not_inferred: every CHAIN triple was checked to satisfy b == a+1 and c == a+2 in component indices
the_chain_is_the_consecutive_triple.count_corroboration: 31 per branch = sum over the 7 isotopes of (A - 1) = 31 = 1+2+2+3+5+7+11, the number of {i, i+1, i+2} on a path of mu = A + 1 components. A count match is corroboration, not evidence, which is why the shape itself is checked
the_chain_is_the_consecutive_triple.forced_by_the_lean: splitsOff_or_consecutive: on the path carrier an ordered triple is separable or is {a, a+1, a+2}, with no third case; consecutive_has_no_separable_component shows the trichotomy is sharp

what_would_close_the_residual.the_invariant_needed: mubar of length k vanishes unless all k indices lie in a single connected-sum summand
what_would_close_the_residual.why_it_would_suffice: combined with the measured 'each summand touches at most 2 components', no summand could hold all three indices of any triple -- closing the chain case and subsuming this file
what_would_close_the_residual.status: NOT asserted and NOT formalised. Axiomatising it as a class would be the axiomatisation-is-not-a-proof pattern

CONTROL_random_non_monotone.note: the positive control. Without a non-monotone arm producing nonzero mubar -- including at Delta = 2 -- the monotone chain null would be indistinguishable from a scanner that never reports nonzero

6679_monotone_null_is_not_vacuous.why_it_could_have_been: Delta = 1 makes mubar = 0 VACUOUSLY, since it lives in Z/1. A null dominated by Delta = 1 would be a count of vacuous zeros
6679_monotone_null_is_not_vacuous.reading: 53.7 % of the monotone arm is NON-vacuous (Delta = 0 or >= 2), 690 triples at exactly Delta = 2, all zero. The null stands

q0AnchorReason: reads no q0. Inputs are braid words, their closures' permutation cycles, integer linking numbers and degree-2 Magnus coefficients. No substrate pin is evaluated on any path.
